faq.beginners_a: Yes. Lessons start with the most common, everyday words and build up gradually, so you don't need any prior English knowledge to get started.
faq.beginners_q: Is Hello Donguri suitable for complete beginners?
faq.cancel_a: There's nothing to cancel — Hello Donguri is free, and you can stop or come back whenever you like.
faq.cancel_q: Can I cancel at any time?
faq.daily_time_a: Just five minutes a day is enough to make steady progress. You can always do more if you're enjoying it.
faq.daily_time_q: How much should I study each day?
faq.free_a: Yes, Hello Donguri is completely free to use during early access.
faq.heading: Everything you might be wondering.
faq.japanese_a: Yes — every word and example comes with a clear Japanese explanation alongside the English.
faq.japanese_q: Are the explanations available in Japanese?
faq.mobile_a: Yes, Hello Donguri works in your phone's browser — no app install required.
faq.mobile_q: Can I use it on my phone?
faq.payment_a: No. You can create an account and start learning without entering any payment information.
faq.payment_q: Do I need to enter payment details?
faq.progress_a: Your progress is saved to your account as you learn, so it's there whenever you come back — on any device.
